workarounds.note: the grid is built row by row from the programme text, and every span goes through mergeCells, which keeps the covered cells in the grid marked hiddenBy

1.4.1 has resource type names and table continuation strings in English and Spanish only, so Taula, Figura and their plurals are written over defaultResourceTypes('ca'), and (continuació) and Continua a la pàgina següent into tableStyle

1.4.1 does not level a chapter's closing page when the rest of a split table opens it (page 4), so a :::columnbreak before Rosa Fontanet's note levels its two columns by hand; check it again whenever the Thursday text changes
the text is ragged, and 1.4.1 has no runt control for ragged text: the last line of every paragraph was read and reworded until it held more than one word
a no-break space still breaks a caption note, so each room of the plan's note is a bare 'sala' chip, which keeps its number and name on one line
the H1 page break is restated in headings.levels[0].breakBefore
col() writes the hex beside each paletteId, and referenceColor is restated: 1.4.1 paints header, footer and opener element colours and the reference colour from the hex
design text lineHeight is given as a multiple

what.en: The programme’s Catalan text, both schedules included, written for this recipe, and the cover, band and floor-plan drawings, generated in code
what.es: El texto catalán del programa, con las dos parrillas, escrito para esta receta, y los dibujos de la cubierta, la banda y el plano, generados en código
